question: On the Curve25519-family curve icv1-fp24-tm1514-dce9313c, is the incumbent-to-rho ratio of 1.52 at w = 0 (24 solves) a small-sample draw, or does tm1514 sit below its four family siblings with many fresh targets; and what does the native work that the 5a band prices at w actually cost relative to one group addition on these curves?

claims.text: Every measured row recovers the discrete logarithm of its public target ([d]G = Q checked by the harness); twin arms that share seeds reproduce their partner's counts exactly.

With 576 fresh solves per arm per curve in each of two replicates (1152 in all), the inc/rho-neg ratio of mean S on tm1514 is (or is not) below the pooled ratio of its four siblings, at w = 0, 0.1 and 1.
claims.if_supported: tm1514 is lower than its siblings on this instrument and design (a curve-level difference within this family; not a statement about other curves or sizes)
claims.if_not_supported: the earlier 1.52 is consistent with a small-sample draw; tm1514 is within the sibling ratio at this resolution

claims.text: The fresh tm1514 ratio at w = 0 is (or is not) compatible with the earlier 1.52.
claims.if_not_supported: the earlier 1.52 lies outside the fresh interval: it was a draw from sampling noise at n = 24

claims.text: Positive control: rho.plain costs more S than rho.negation on every curve (expected ratio near sqrt 2), so the instrument resolves a known method effect at this n.

Measured on the L2 node, one unit of each arm's priced native work (rho-neg: one negation canonicalisation; inc: one walk-table lookup) costs w_meas group additions, with a 95% interval; the w = 1 end of the band is (or is not) above that interval.
claims.if_supported: the upper end of the measured price interval is below 0.5 GAE per native operation; the band point at w_meas is reported beside 0 / 0.1 / 1 as a measured calibration point, never replacing the band
claims.if_not_supported: the measured price is not resolved below 1; the w = 1 verdict stands as unresolved

claims.text: At the measured prices (each arm's native work at its own measured unit price, and both at the larger of the two), the tm1514 inc/rho-neg ratio is (or is not) above 1.
claims.if_supported: the w = 1 flip on tm1514 does not survive measured pricing on this host class

claims.text: Nothing here is a security statement about Curve25519 or a claim about sizes other than k = 24; a host-class price is not a portable constant.

hypotheses.statement: tm1514's 1.52 is a small-sample draw: with enough fresh targets inc/rho on tm1514 is not below the siblings' ratio.
hypotheses.mechanism: inc's per-solve S has a heavy right tail (two collisions in a random walk table plus probes); with 12 targets x 2 rounds the mean can sit 15-20% low by chance. rho-neg on tm1514 (1.253) is inside the sibling range (1.03-1.29); the low ratio comes from inc (1.90 against 2.11-2.22).

power.note: Per curve and arm: 96 targets x 6 rounds = 576 solves per replicate (1152 over A+B; the brief's floor was 256). Bootstrap resamples targets (all rounds of a target together), B = 10000 per interval, Bonferroni over the three weights of C1 (98.33% intervals). Resolution check (to be confirmed on the dry-run): if per-solve S has coefficient of variation about 0.5 for each arm, the SE of a per-curve mean at n = 576 is about 2%, so the ratio interval half-width is about 6% at 98.33% and the tm1514-vs-pooled-siblings difference resolves about 0.12 in ratio (against an observed gap of 0.2-0.6). That CV is an assumption from rho theory, not measured here; the dry-run on the earlier k = 24 records (main session, S3) must confirm it before freezing.

Budget 50 ms per execution for 16800 executions (840 s) + 336 s replay-all at 20 ms + 60 s run-ecbench sleep + compare + provisioning about 5 min.

stop and report invalid if the positive control C2 fails its expected detection

invalidation_rules: a replicate whose audit is not ok, whose replays do not all reproduce, whose L2 gate fails, or whose wall A/A is not admitted is invalid for C3 and reported; its counts may still serve C1 and C2 only if the audit and replays pass
a twin pair (rho-neg/rho-neg-aa or inc/inc-aa) whose counts differ on any (workload, round) invalidates the session's determinism claim C0 and the session
a preempted or killed job has no session and contributes nothing; it is reported and charged
exhausted or timeout rows are kept as right-censored rows and reported per arm; a curve whose arm has any censored row is reported with and without them and cannot decide C1 alone

decision_rule.text: C1: compute D(w) = ln R_tm1514(w) - ln R_sib(w) with a paired bootstrap over targets (stratified by curve, replicates A and B pooled as rounds of the same targets), 98.33% interval (Bonferroni over w in {0, 0.1, 1}). Verdict at each w: 'tm1514 lower than siblings' if the interval lies below 0; 'tm1514 higher than siblings' if it lies above 0; otherwise 'within the sibling ratio (draw not excluded)'. The interval alone decides; tm1514's seed-independent A/A interval of ln R (replicate A against B at the same w) and the five-curve pooled one are reported beside it, not used as a second bar, since the D interval already carries sampling error. The interval-non-overlap reading of the brief (tm1514's R interval entirely below the pooled sibling interval) is reported as a secondary, more conservative line. C1b: 'the earlier 1.52 was a draw' if the 95% interval of R_tm1514(0) excludes 1.52; 'compatible with 1.52' otherwise. C0: 'C0 holds' if every measured row verifies and the twins reproduce exactly. C2: 'positive control detected' if the pooled rho-plain/rho-neg 95% interval has lower end >= 1.20 and every per-curve point estimate > 1.10; otherwise the study is invalid. C3: w_meas with 95% interval per unit; H2's price prediction holds for a unit if the upper end is below 0.5. C4: 'the w = 1 flip does not survive measured pricing' if R_tm1514(w_meas) has a 95% interval above 1 under both pricing variants; 'unresolved at measured pricing' otherwise. The 5a band verdicts at 0 / 0.1 / 1 are always reported; the measured point never replaces them.
decision_rule.threshold: interval excludes 0 (D), excludes 1.52 (C1b), lower end >= 1.20 (C2), upper end < 0.5 (C3), lower end > 1 (C4)
decision_rule.statistic: ratio of summed priced S (ecbench totals ratio, AGENTS.md section 8); D as a log ratio difference
decision_rule.interval: paired bootstrap over targets, B = 10000, percentile; 98.33% for C1, 95% otherwise
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: ratio and log-ratio difference; per-curve ratios with intervals; A/A half-width beside every effect
verdict_vocabulary: within the sibling ratio (draw not excluded)
the w = 1 flip does not survive measured pricing

crypto..controls.aa.note: Two kinds. (1) Seed-independent A/A, the noise floor for C1: replicate A versus replicate B, the same spec except measurement.seed, so every (workload, measured round) pair has the same target and an independent algorithm seed; compared with ecbench compare --b-dir (counts only; wall is refused across sessions by design). Secondary: within one session, odd versus even measured rounds of the same arm (each round has its own algorithm seed). (2) Same-session twins rho-neg-aa and inc-aa share every algorithm seed with their partner (spec.rs: one seed per (workload, round), shared by every arm); they measure determinism, not variance, and give isolab its wall-clock A/A admission (run-ecbench compares the first reference arm with the first control arm).

crypto..variable_ledger.comparisons[C-aa-seed-i: replicate A vs B, same workloads, every curve
crypto..variable_ledger.comparisons[C-price-can: w_canon from L2 solve wall time (and hw cycles if the node exposes a PMU)
crypto..variable_ledger.comparisons[C-price-loo: w_lookup from inc's relations-phase wall_ns against the add price
crypto..execution.note: Two ordinary isolab.eks.request/v1 jobs (replicates A and B), resumable false, dispatched through isolab-experiment.yml on main with one source_revision; zero automatic retries; a failed job is recorded and needs a new decision, not an automatic resubmission.
crypto..analysis_plan.script_note: examples/tm1514_analyze.rs (crypto repository path; source copy in analysis/tm1514_analyze.rs), built with cargo build --release --example tm1514_analyze and run as tm1514_analyze --a sessions/A --b sessions/B --wall-a A/control-comparison.json --wall-b B/control-comparison.json --out analysis. It reads both sessions through the ecbench record types, prices with ecbench::band::priced_s, resamples with ecbench::stats::Resampler seeded with the analysis bootstrap seed above (B = 10000), masks arm labels with key-derived codes until every verdict is computed, and writes analysis/result.json and analysis/summary.txt deterministically. ecbench compare --b-dir and ecbench band give the cross-checks.
